question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are longer than 10 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 600000

question: List the names of all media types.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

question: Which countries do customers come from? List each country once.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM Customer

question: What is the total amount of all invoices combined?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice

question: What is the email address of the customer named Leonie Köhler?
gold_sql: SELECT Email FROM Customer WHERE FirstName = 'Leonie' AND LastName = 'Köhler'

question: How many employees have the title 'Sales Support Agent'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: What is the most expensive invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(Total) FROM Invoice

question: How many invoices were billed to customers in Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'Brazil'

question: List the first and last names of customers who live in Prague.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE City = 'Prague'

question: What is the average track length in seconds?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) / 1000.0 FROM Track

question: How many invoices were issued in 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2022'

question: How many tracks belong to the Rock genre?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

question: List the titles of all albums by AC/DC.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: Which artist has the most albums? Give the artist name.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each country, how many customers are there? Return country and count.
gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country

question: What is the total sales amount per billing country? Return country and total.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

question: Which genre has the most tracks? Give the genre name.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are in the playlist named '90’s Music'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = '90’s Music'

question: Who is the manager (ReportsTo) of the employee Jane Peacock? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT m.FirstName, m.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE e.FirstName = 'Jane' AND e.LastName = 'Peacock'

question: How many customers does each sales support agent look after? Return the agent's first name, last name and count.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

question: What is the average invoice total for customers in Germany?
evidence: Use the customer's country, not the billing country.
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(i.Total) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Germany'

question: How many distinct customers bought at least one Jazz track?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

question: Which media type has the most tracks? Give its name.
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of tracks on the album 'Let There Be Rock'.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: What was the total revenue for each year? Return year and total.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate)

question: Which customer has spent the most money in total? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which sales support agent generated the most total invoice revenue through their customers? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which artist has earned the most revenue from track sales? Give the artist name.
evidence: Revenue = UnitPrice * Quantity on invoice lines.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

question: List the names of artists who have no albums.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM Album)

question: What are the top 3 best-selling genres by number of tracks sold? Return genre names.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which customers have spent more than 45 dollars in total? Return first name, last name and total spent.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING SUM(i.Total) > 45

question: Which album has the longest total running time? Give the album title.
gold_sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId ORDER BY SUM(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For the country with the most customers, how many invoices were billed to it?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = (SELECT Country FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

question: How many playlists contain at least one track by Iron Maiden?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'

question: What percentage of all tracks are in the MPEG audio file media type? Return a single number between 0 and 100.
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.Name = 'MPEG audio file' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId

question: Which employees were hired before their manager? Return the employee's first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE e.HireDate < m.HireDate

question: Which country had the highest total sales in 2023 by billing country?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2023' GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have bought tracks from more than 10 different genres?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i.CustomerId FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY i.CustomerId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 10)
